title: Three-dimensional anatomy and dorsoventral asymmetry of the mature Marchantia polymorpha meristem develops from a symmetrical gemma meristem.
authors: Spencer, Victoria; Wallner, Eva-Sophie; Jandrasits, Katharina; Edelbacher, Natalie; Mosiolek, Magdalena; Dolan, Liam
one_liner_zh: 该文研究地钱分生组织的三维解剖与背腹不对称发育，属于植物发育生物学，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Meristems are three-dimensional (3D) generative structures that contain stem cells and produce new organs and tissues. Meristems develop in all land plants; however we know little about the spatial and temporal regulation of meristem structure in lineages such as bryophytes. Here, we describe the 3D meristem anatomy during the development of the liverwort Marchantia polymorpha. We show that the apical stem cell of the mature meristem is sub-apical, ventral, and in the outer cell layer. Mature meristem anatomy is therefore asymmetrical in the dorsoventral axis, which is reflected by the domain-specific protein localisation of Class III and Class IV Homeodomain-Leucine-Zippers (MpC3HDZ and MpC4HDZ), and by the promoter activity of MpYUCCA2. The dorsoventral asymmetry that defines the mature meristem is absent in the juvenile meristems of asexual propagules known as gemmae. We discovered that anatomical dorsoventral asymmetry of the meristem forms after 1 to 2 days of gemmaling growth, and is accompanied by expression of the dorsal identity reporter MpC3HDZ. We conclude that the gemma meristem has arrested development and undergoes anatomical rearrangement to develop the 3D meristem structure of the mature plant.
abstract_zh: 分生组织是三维（3D）生成结构，包含干细胞并产生新器官和组织。分生组织在所有陆地植物中发育；然而，我们对苔藓植物等谱系中分生组织结构的空间和时间调控知之甚少。在此，我们描述了地钱（*Marchantia polymorpha*）发育过程中的3D分生组织解剖结构。我们表明，成熟分生组织的顶端干细胞位于亚顶端、腹侧，并处于外层细胞中。因此，成熟分生组织的解剖结构在背腹轴上是不对称的，这反映在Class III和Class IV同源域-亮氨酸拉链（MpC3HDZ和MpC4HDZ）的域特异性蛋白定位，以及MpYUCCA2启动子活性上。定义成熟分生组织的背腹不对称性在无性繁殖体（称为芽胞）的幼期分生组织中不存在。我们发现，分生组织的解剖背腹不对称性在芽胞体生长1至2天后形成，并伴随背侧身份报告基因MpC3HDZ的表达。我们得出结论，芽胞分生组织发育停滞，并进行解剖重排以发育成熟植物的3D分生组织结构。
